penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: Salesforce Agentforce CI/CD remediation requires deep environment-specific diagnosis; each deployment failure is unique and demands hands-on investigation, not automated delivery.

penalties_applied.name: requires_synchronous_human
penalties_applied.reason: Enterprise Salesforce buyers expect scoped discovery calls and onboarding sessions before committing; a pure self-serve play is implausible here.

rationale: The buyer is identifiable — Salesforce DevOps engineers at Agentforce-invested companies — and the pain is real (broken builds block shipping velocity). However, the solution fundamentally requires per-customer manual investigation: Agentforce deployment failures are environment-specific, underdocumented, and cannot be fixed by a generic automated tool without deep Salesforce platform knowledge and hands-on org access. Operational autonomy is low (score 3) and buildability with AI is limited (score 4), and after penalties the total collapses to 2.7. This is consulting work, not an autonomous micro-service.
solution_plan: A solo non-technical operator could NOT realistically build, sell, and maintain this autonomously. The problem requires a certified Salesforce developer who can access customer scratch orgs, debug Metadata API edge cases, and iterate on deployment scripts — none of which a Claude factory can do reliably without platform-level access and deep Salesforce expertise. Dropping is the right call.
notes: Fails operational_autonomy_min (3 < 7), buildability_with_ai_min (4 < 6). Total also falls below min_total_to_validate after penalties.
